STARTING POINT

Bring the problem, not a perfect brief.

A WordPress project should define who edits the content, which plugins are necessary, and how updates and backups will be handled.

We can define pages, platform and priorities from there.

QUESTIONS / ANSWERED

Good questions deserve direct answers.

Will I be able to edit the site myself?

Yes. We can choose editable templates and document the changes you make most often. Plugins and updates still need a maintenance plan.

How do we decide the timeline and cost?

I first review the scope, content readiness, integrations and review process. Then we can define deliverables and a realistic estimate before work begins.

Do you work with clients outside Jabalpur?

Yes. I am based in Jabalpur and can handle discovery, reviews and delivery remotely for suitable projects.
